name: Chikage
source:
Tengu - Black-Winged Demon

Weakness: Not intimidating when he smiles

"Don't bother me, human."

Nothing ruffles Chikage's feathers. He may seem cold, but his feelings for you are far from tepid...

"You smell fantastic...What is this feeling?"

Miyabi: "Chikage tries to play it cool, but that's all an act."
Kyoga: "Miyabi might be right. Chikage's a sweetheart. He's much more sensitive than he lets on."

[From [url=https://voltageapps.com/love365/apps/enchanted-in-the-moonlight/]English official site[/url]]
